overview_description.description:
Dealat encourages people to try a different store each day by offering special deals and discounted prices.

Dealat is the marketplace of deals. The products and services listed on the mobile application are offered at huge discounts and are referred to as deals. Dealat creates value through the low prices it offers but also through the convenience and accessibility of the wide-range of deals we provide. Our initial value proposition is to help local businesses introduce people to their businesses, thus allowing companies to acquire future potential clients.

DealNews provides the best deals available on computers, technology, gadgets, and other items.
